instruction: Please enable the minimal view mode in VLC media player. I prefer a cleaner, more streamlined interface without all the extra buttons and controls cluttering the screen.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
